name: Serizawa Manami
source:
She is a popular classmate in the same second grade as the main character. She boasts of her good looks and style, which attracts a lot of attention in the school. She has a friendly and open personality, and has known the main character since they were in the first grade.

Although they did not have much interaction when they first met, they came to open up to each other after a certain incident. Recently, they have been making light conversation, and can be described as close friends.

Basically, she is a normal, modern girl who loves cute accessories and clothes. On her days off, she goes shopping with her friend Yoshikawa and others.
Because of her character, she rarely shows it to the public, but in fact, she has a sullen disposition and is very interested in sex. 

Once she gets into something, she is always absorbed in it. She comforts herself with agonizing thoughts and feelings every day. One chance led her to become interested in two-dimensional things such as doujinshi.
